Did you know?
  • Sarah is not only angry — she is also worried about her friend.
  • Estelle does not refuse the friendship; she asks for space.
  • The problem ends with an apology and an invitation to dinner.

📖Read the text اقرأ النص

Read

00:00 / 00:00 اسحب على الشريط للتنقّل · اضغط أى كلمة فى النص للانتقال إليها

Part 1 — "I am very mad at you" Estelle: Hello? Sarah: Hi, Estelle. How are you? Estelle: I’m doing well, thanks. How are you? Sarah: I’m not doing very well. I am very mad at you. Estelle: You are angry with me? What did I do? I have not seen you in over a month. Sarah: I know and that is the issue. You do not have time for me anymore. You’re my only friend. This new job is taking all of your time. I am so angry with you, but I am also worried. How can you be working so much? Estelle: What do you want me to do, Sarah? I cannot take time off from this job since I just started. It is really a great job opportunity and it is the appropriate job for me. You should be happy for me!

Read

00:00 / 00:00 اسحب على الشريط للتنقّل · اضغط أى كلمة فى النص للانتقال إليها

Part 2 — "Please forgive me" Sarah: I am happy that you got a job you love, but I am your best friend. I need to see you! You didn’t even call me last week! We always talk on Fridays. What happened? Estelle: I am really sorry, Sarah. You know that you are my best friend in the entire world, but I really need you to give me some space right now. I am working crazy hours at this job. We are working on a project right now that is extremely critical. It is my first project with this company and I want to make sure everything goes right. Please don’t be angry at me. I need your support. Sarah: Oh! That sounds exciting. Do you need any help? Estelle: I just need your support. I am really sorry, Sarah. Please forgive me. I will take you to dinner this weekend. Sarah: Ummm …. One dinner won’t make me forgive you, but it’s a start!

❓Scan the text, then answer اقرأ النص سريعاً ثم أجب

1- •
اعرض الإجابة
• What is the main idea of the text? Sarah is angry with her best friend Estelle because Estelle’s new job leaves her no time for their friendship. Estelle explains that she needs space for a critical first project, apologises, and invites Sarah to dinner.

❓Answer the following questions أجب عن الأسئلة الآتية

1- Why is Sarah angry with Estelle?
اعرض الإجابة
Because Estelle no longer has time for her — her new job is taking all of her time and they have not seen each other in over a month.
2- How often do Sarah and Estelle meet?
اعرض الإجابة
They always talk on Fridays, but they have not met for over a month.
3- What is Estelle’s excuse?
اعرض الإجابة
She has just started a great new job and she is working crazy hours on her first project with the company.
4- Why can’t Estelle take some time off?
اعرض الإجابة
Because she has just started the job, and she is working on an extremely critical project — her first with the company.
5- Sarah is angry and worried. Explain.
اعرض الإجابة
She is angry because Estelle has no time for her anymore, and she is worried because Estelle is working so much.
6- How will Estelle make it up for Sarah?
اعرض الإجابة
She apologised, asked for forgiveness, and promised to take Sarah to dinner at the weekend.

⚖️Write (True) or (False) صح أم خطأ مع التصحيح

Correct the false statements.

1- Sarah and Estelle work at the same company.
اعرض الإجابة
False — Only Estelle has just started this new job — Sarah does not work with her.
2- Sarah is Estelle’s only friend.
اعرض الإجابة
False — It is the opposite: Sarah says "You’re my only friend" — Estelle is Sarah’s only friend.
3- Sarah and Estelle used to talk daily.
اعرض الإجابة
False — They always talked on Fridays, that is once a week — not daily.
4- Estelle will invite Sarah for dinner.
اعرض الإجابة
True
5- Sarah and Estelle haven’t met for over a week.
اعرض الإجابة
False — They have not seen each other in over a month.

📝Complete the paragraph أكمل الفقرة الآتية

صفحة 15 من الكتاب — مكتب العمل — الضغط والانشغال

Use your own words to complete the paragraph below.

Estelle and Sarah have been ……………… for a long time. They used to call each other every ……………… . However, Estelle is quite ……………… because she has got a new ……………… . She thinks it is her life ……………… . The problem is that she is working on her first ……………… and she needs some ……………… .

اعرض الإجابة
Estelle and Sarah have been best friends for a long time. They used to call each other every Friday . However, Estelle is quite busy because she has got a new job . She thinks it is her life opportunity . The problem is that she is working on her first project and she needs some space .

❓Think and discuss فكّر وناقش

1- If you were Sarah, how would you react to Estelle’s situation?
اعرض الإجابة
I would try to understand her. Starting a new job is stressful, and a real friend supports her friend instead of blaming her. I would tell her that I am proud of her, agree on a fixed time to talk every week, and offer help whenever she needs it.
2- What is something you can never forgive your friend for? Why?
اعرض الإجابة
I could never forgive a friend who lies to me or shares my secrets with others, because friendship is built on trust — once trust is broken, the friendship loses its meaning.

🖊️Writing التعبير الكتابي

  • To write a dialogue, you need to:
  • Show rather than tell — characters speak and act to become real to the reader.
  • Build tension and drama — this helps to further the plot.
  • Increase the tension and move the story forward.
Create a dialogue between Estelle and Sarah on the night they had dinner. Make the dialogue as interesting and catchy as possible.
